defects.what: Line 32 pads a description shorter than 70 characters with the PLATFORM line and then cuts it to 155 with cutAtWord; for a text of about 34 to 69 characters the cut falls inside the platform line, so the meta description ends mid-sentence ('...residential property in.' or '...California, New York and.') or names only California (R46: the markets are California, New York and Florida). Two of the first four bundled stories already produce 'Matter of Place is an editorial real-estate media platform for residential property in.' Rule: the padding sentence is appended whole or not at all (choose a shorter platform line when the text plus the full sentence exceeds 155, never cut inside it); add a unit case over every bundled story and property description asserting no description ends mid-sentence and every one that names markets names all three; watched-fail it.
defects.evidence: The review's bun probe over storyDescription(stories[i]) printed 'Why houses in Tiburon and Mill Valley are built for the afternoon. Matter of Place is an editorial real-estate media platform for residential property in.'
